title: Give Jade Slips
text:
/cultivation givejadeslip <player> <entry>


Tab suggests available knowledge IDs, including recipes. The command gives one unread slip; it does not unlock knowledge directly.


Refine the slip to learn its entry.


Example:
/cultivation givejadeslip @s cultivationcraft:refinement


Recipe example:
/cultivation givejadeslip @s cultivationcraft:recipes/spirit_recovery


Tab can search spirit_recovery or a generated pill name. Unique short IDs are also accepted.
